mapper.select: SELECT EMAIL_ID, USER_ID, SUBJECT, CONTENT, RECEIVER_EMAIL, RESERVE_DATETIME FROM EMAIL_RESERVATION WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING' AND RESERVE_DATETIME <= #{now} ORDER BY RESERVE_DATETIME ASC, EMAIL_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE EMAIL_RESERVATION SET STATUS = 'PROCESSING', UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EMAIL_ID = #{emailId} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
UPDATE EMAIL_RESERVATION SET STATUS = 'QUEUED', UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EMAIL_ID = #{emailId} AND STATUS = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE EMAIL_RESERVATION SET STATUS = 'FAILED', UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EMAIL_ID = #{emailId} AND STATUS = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMAIL_QUEUE ( EMAIL_ID, EXCHANGE_NAME, ROUTING_KEY, MESSAGE_ID, PAYLOAD, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{emailId}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, #{messageId}, #{payload, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{status} )
INSERT INTO EMAIL_SEND_LOG ( EMAIL_ID, QUEUE_ID, STATUS, MESSAGE ) VALUES ( #{emailId}, #{queueId}, #{status}, #{message} )
